source: User transcription of in-game category help; no direct UI/screenshot inspection performed.
rawUserInput:
잠깐만. 인게임에 각 항목에 대한 설명이 있어.

종합력
멤버 파라미터 : 편성 멤버의 합계 파라미터
의상스킬 : 의상 스킬(파라미터 상승)의 효과량
홀로멤 보드효과 : 홀로멤 보드(파라미터 상승)의 효과량
패시브스킬 : 패시브스킬(파라미터 상승)의 효과량
메모리효과 : 보유 메모리 수에 따른 보너스 효과량
멤버강화보너스 : 멤버강화에 따른 보너스 효과량

스코어보너스
의상스킬 : 의상스킬(스코어보너스) 효과
액티브스킬 : 액티브스킬 효과
홀로멤보드 : 홀로멤보드(스코어보너스) 효과
패시브스킬 : 패시브 스킬(스코어보너스) 효과
스페셜스킬 : 스페셜 스킬 효과

이 부분 참고해줘.

establishedByText: Power categories describe parameter/bonus amounts by their named source.
Score categories describe effects of their named skill/board source.
Memory effect is described as a bonus based on the number of owned memories.
notEstablishedByText: Independent calculation of each category with every other effect disabled.
Internal attribution order or a shared pool divided between board and passive.
Which Ririka leader node causes the AG/AH passive-display difference.

interpretationUpdate.terminology: Use per-source effect calculation and interactions. Prior allocation/split wording is a research accounting hypothesis, not a documented in-game process.
interpretationUpdate.AG_AH: Noel support9 and member conditions remain the same under the planned leader-only swap; the passive score-effect display changes1.7 to2.2 with costumes inactive. Preserve the observation without relabeling the0.5 as board score.
interpretationUpdate.activeSP: The current board-excluded base formulas remain empirical matches to32 observations, consistent with source labels but not proven by labels alone.
interpretationUpdate.jointModel: Board+passive combined calculations remain diagnostic compatibility checks, not proof of a shared game pool or a correct per-source formula.
interpretationUpdate.AI: The frozen post-AH displayed-passive conversion candidate remains an unvalidated empirical proposal. Category labels alone neither validate nor refute it; defer the next measurement request while incorporating the definitions.
